title: Flat canopy, depth 3
notes: Thin flat canopy of top slabs (or closed top trapdoors) projecting 3 block(s) at one level, with a band in the wall plane behind (a slab/trapdoor line, Detail pp.20-21; Harlo canopy = top smooth-stone slabs). Projects only within the envelope allowance. Cell "props" are merged into the palette block only where that block has the property (format note in COMPONENTS.md).
